name: passkeyRegister
description: Starts registering a passkey (WebAuthn/FIDO2) for a user. Call CFPasskey.startRegistration() in JavaScript to prompt the browser.

params.name: user
params.description: Struct describing the user. name (such as an email address) is required. Optional keys: displayName, id, rpName, rpId, userVerification, authenticatorAttachment, requireResidentKey and attestation.

params.name: config
params.description: Struct with optional keys successHandler and errorHandler (JavaScript function names), redirectUrl (page that receives ?passkey_token=) and service (CFC used to store credentials; defaults to /CFIDE/passkey/DefaultPasskey.cfc, which is for development only).
